incidents.name: Incident on 2010-07-29 02:06:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-07-29 02:06:00 - We're moving search over to a beefier machine and it's causing some disruption. Should be back soon.
  • 2010-07-29 02:43:00 - Search is back and better than ever. All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-07-20 21:53:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-07-20 21:53:00 - A recent deploy caused high load on frontend machines. Rolling back...
  • 2010-07-20 22:06:00 - Rollback complete, site should be stable again.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-07-14 23:29:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-07-14 23:29:00 - Spoke too soon. Seeing problems again on one of the file servers.
  • 2010-07-15 00:24:00 - All file servers are back online and operating normally. For real this time.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-07-14 23:03:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-07-14 23:03:00 - Seeing high load on some file servers. Some repos may be temporarily unavailable while we determine the source.
  • 2010-07-14 23:23:00 - All file servers are back online and operating normally.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-07-14 01:01:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-07-14 01:01:00 - Shutting down background workers and running DB maintenance now - hang tight!\r\n\r\nMore
  • 2010-07-14 01:14:00 - Git access needed to be disabled for about 5 minutes. Should be back now for everything except forks. Maintenance window continues ... Hold tight!
  • 2010-07-14 01:42:00 - Intermittent errors across the site (Repositories, Accounts, Issues, etc.) due to database maintenance. We're trying to finish things up now.
  • 2010-07-14 01:59:00 - DB maintenance complete. The queues are catching up.
  • 2010-07-14 02:30:00 - Queues are all caught up and the site is behaving normally. All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-07-11 16:50:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-07-11 16:50:00 - Site is 500'ing due to a bad deploy. Rolling back.
  • 2010-07-11 17:08:00 - Bad deploy was rolled back. All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-07-08 21:17:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-07-08 21:17:00 - Something is causing resource starvation on our frontends. We are looking into it.
  • 2010-07-08 21:20:00 - Load has returned to normal. Site should load normally now.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-07-02 03:00:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-07-02 03:00:00 - One partition of one file server will be down for maintenance for a short time. Repos on that partition will be unavailable.
  • 2010-07-02 04:55:00 - File server maintenance is complete.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-07-01 00:07:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-07-01 00:07:00 - One of the file servers is misbehaving. Looking into it.
  • 2010-07-01 00:20:00 - File server is back to normal.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-06-29 08:06:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-06-29 08:06:00 - We're aware of the broken git pushing and are deploying a fix right now.
  • 2010-06-29 08:08:00 - Pushes are working again. There was no data loss, but post-receive hooks were not run properly on affected pushes.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-06-29 06:08:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-06-29 06:08:00 - Downloads server for public repos is temporarily down. We're looking into it.
  • 2010-06-29 06:34:00 - Downloads should be fine now. We're running on the old server for all repo downloads until the kinks are worked out on the new one.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-06-24 04:55:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-06-24 04:55:00 - We're bringing one of the fileservers offline to swap in the new one. This should take around 10 minutes.
  • 2010-06-24 05:00:00 - The new fileserver was swapped in without any issues. All systems go!

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-06-22 05:00:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-06-22 05:00:00 - It's maintenance time! We're bringing down the background jobs and preparing to update the database. Repos will be readonly on the web, and fully accessible through git/SSH. This should only take about 10 minutes or so.
  • 2010-06-22 05:03:00 - The job runners are crunching through the queue backlog, and things should be back to normal in a few minutes.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-06-11 16:43:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-06-11 16:43:00 - Intermittent memcached errors, we're working on it.
  • 2010-06-11 18:22:00 - There were some issues with the zip/tarball downloads, things should be working again.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-06-10 22:50:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-06-10 22:50:00 - Emergency maintenance on one (out of five) of our file servers. Some repositories may be temporarily unavailable.
  • 2010-06-11 01:22:00 - There were complications with the failover of the file server. We're working on getting it back online.
  • 2010-06-11 01:40:00 - We have the server back up but not yet back in rotation. Need to run some verifications first.
  • 2010-06-11 02:43:00 - Extended disk checks need to run on the failed file server. ETA for the server to be back online and functional is 1 hour.
  • 2010-06-11 03:48:00 - The file server is back online.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-06-07 11:30:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-06-07 11:30:00 - Issues was unavailable for about 10 minutes due to a bug.
  • 2010-06-07 11:43:00 - The bug is now fixed.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-05-29 05:00:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-05-29 05:00:00 - Site's going down for schedule maintenance RIGHT NOW. We'll be back shortly.
  • 2010-05-29 05:10:00 - And we're back. Thanks for your patience.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-05-29 04:00:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2010-05-29 04:00:00 - Site's going down for scheduled maintenance in one hour.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-05-28 03:46:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2010-05-28 03:46:00 - The site will be down for maintenance tomorrow (Friday, May 28, 2010) starting at 22:00 PST for a (long due) Redis upgrade. We expect the outage to last only a few minutes and plan to roll back if downtime exceeds 15 minutes. During this time, the site an

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-05-23 03:45:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-05-23 03:45:00 - One of the file servers is experiencing heavy load and is responding slowly. Looking into it.
  • 2010-05-23 03:46:00 - Forced failover of the rogue file server, investigating the root cause. All file servers are now responding normally.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-05-21 20:37:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-05-21 20:37:00 - Site is unreachable for some users. There seems to be a network issue from certain regions / service providers. We're investigating.
  • 2010-05-21 20:54:00 - It appears connectivity has been restored for everyone. Thanks all who reported in with status from their region. Big help.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-05-21 19:45:16 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-05-21 19:45:16 - Site updates after push are delayed. The queues backed up for a few minutes but are catching up now.
  • 2010-05-21 19:54:10 - Everything operating normally

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-05-20 09:30:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-05-20 09:30:00 - Forking a repository is hanging for some users. We're investigating.
  • 2010-05-20 10:02:00 - Forking is back to normal. All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-05-19 12:46:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2010-05-19 12:46:00 - HAProxy on one of the file servers crashed and needed a manual restart causing a few minutes of unavailability for repos on that file server. We'll get HAProxy under surveillance so this doesn't happen again.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-05-05 22:35:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2010-05-05 22:35:00 - All queues are caught up, everything should be good to go

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-05-05 21:59:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2010-05-05 21:59:00 - Queues are temporarily backed up, operations may be slow for the next few minutes.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-05-01 07:31:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-05-01 07:31:00 - Forking malfunction. If you forked and are stuck on "Hardcore Forking Action", hold tight - they should fill in shortly.
  • 2010-05-01 07:57:00 - Forking is back to normal. All systems go.
